Netflix Billing Inquiry - Drafted for Household Admin Batch (123 Maple Street, Apt 4B)

---

Alice Chen  
123 Maple Avenue, Apt 4B  
Springfield, IL 62704

August 28, 2026

Netflix, Inc.  
Billing Disputes Department  
100 Winchester Circle  
Los Gatos, CA 95032

**Subject: Billing Dispute - Account alice.chen.streaming@personalmail.com - Unexpected Charge Amount**

Account Information:
- Account Holder: Alice Chen
- Account Email: alice.chen.streaming@personalmail.com
- Service Plan: Standard HD
- Payment Method: Visa card ending in 4242, expiry 12/27
- Billing Address: 123 Maple Avenue, Springfield, IL 62704

Dear Netflix Billing Department,

I am writing to formally inquire about an unexpected charge on my Netflix subscription account. My Standard HD subscription has historically billed $17.99 per month to my Visa ending in 4242, but this month's charge came through at a different amount, which requires clarification.

REQUEST FOR ITEMIZED BREAKDOWN:
To properly evaluate this unexpected charge, I require an itemized breakdown of my most recent billing statement showing:
- Base subscription fee amount
- Applicable taxes and jurisdiction
- Any additional fees or surcharges
- Total amount charged to Visa 4242

This itemized breakdown will help me understand the composition of the charge and verify its accuracy against my expected billing amount of $17.99.

My Netflix subscription has been active with consistent billing at $17.99 per month since April 2025, following a rate adjustment from the previous $15.49 monthly charge. I am seeking clarification on whether this month's charge reflects a plan modification, additional fees, or a billing error.

I respectfully request:
1. An itemized breakdown of my most recent billing statement showing all charge components
2. Documentation of any rate adjustments or plan modifications applied to my account
3. Verification that the charge to Visa 4242 was properly authorized for the stated amount

Please respond within ten (10) business days with the requested itemized breakdown and resolution.

I can be reached via return email at alice.chen.streaming@personalmail.com or by reply to this correspondence. My account is set to auto-renew, and I wish to ensure all charges are accurate and properly documented going forward.

I appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

Alice Chen
Account Holder

---

**Household Admin Batch Context:** This inquiry is coordinated with other 123 Maple Street, Apt 4B maintenance items including the upcoming BugFree Pest Control quarterly service visit with technician Carlos Martinez and preparations for Mom's upcoming visit.
